config.label: Warp API key (wak_live_* or wak_test_*)
config.description: Warp API key (wak_live_* or wak_test_*). Optional — the package prefers ~/.warp/config.json populated by `warp-agent signup` or `warp-agent login`.

config.label: Override the API base URL
config.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://www.wearewarp.com/api/v1/warp (the warp-site proxy that accepts wak_* tokens). Set to https://gw.wearewarp.com/api/v1 for direct gateway access with a raw customer key.
